description: Figure 9 presents a bar chart illustrating the performance scores of several models across a range of datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” lists the categories GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBpp, LC-AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench, and Chat-Arena-Hard, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are displayed for each dataset, representing the models LLaMA-3-8B-inst (green), Ours (SFT baseline) (blue), and Ours (iterative RLHF) (red). Within each category, the bars are grouped side-by-side, with LLaMA-3-8B-inst consistently achieving the highest scores, reaching approximately 76% on GSM-8K and 72% on MMLU, while the “Ours (SFT baseline)” and “Ours (iterative RLHF)” models generally have lower scores, ranging from approximately 30% to 60% across the datasets. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
